create_permute_tokens: permute token hidden states by expert using gather indices for grouped GEMM ordering
create_unpermute_tokens: unpermute grouped GEMM outputs back to original token order using scatter indices
calculate_topk_experts: calculate top-k expert routing weights and IDs with softmax or sigmoid activation and renormalization
get_routing_indices: get per-expert token counts and sorted gather indices for routing tokens to experts
run_torch_grouped_gemm: run grouped matrix multiplication across expert weights with dynamic per-expert token counts
